# Salcedo Group, Inc. (SGI)

> Civil engineering, land surveying and GIS firm in Grand Prairie, Texas, founded in 2002 by Luis M. Salcedo. Both principals are registered as Professional Engineer and Registered Professional Land Surveyor, with two in-house survey crews. NCTRCA certified M/DBE, SBA Small Disadvantaged Business, TxDOT precertified. Texas PE Firm F-5482, TBPLS Firm 10070800.

Office: 401 College Street, Grand Prairie, Texas 75050 · (214) 412-3122
